levels.surface: أبو يعقوب يوسف بن محمد بن زياد
أبو الحسن علي بن محمد بن سيار

notes: the Hasan's answer on «بسم الله» is saying 1; the Imam is written after «عن» so narrator (owner ruling 2), and he is the last link of that route

the second saying is Ali b. Husayn's answer inside the same text, with its own transmitters «حدثني أبي، عن أخيه الحسن، عن أبيه أمير المؤمنين» (rule 4a); no head for it is written, so its start is a ruling
Ali's words are the saying; «أبيه» before «أمير المؤمنين» is one link (rule 7); the Sadiq's answer and the Prophet's citation are quoted inside saying 1 and have no own chain
«عليهما السلام» and «رضي الله عنه» are not part of any surface
